narrative.overview:
The site is a developer-tool page in Void's own family look (benchmark: void.cloud), played straight. Its centrepiece is real code and the line that code renders in the page's own language; everything around it is quiet so that proof carries the page. A near-black ground with a faint blue cast, white ink, one violet accent, and 1px rules that divide sections into a grid. No gradient heroes, no glow, no marketing claims.

The world is always dark. `void.config.ts` sets `head.htmlAttrs` to `class="dark"` and `data-theme="dark"` on `<html>` of every page (no wrapper class): `dark` turns on the `.dark` palette in `pages/style.css`, and `data-theme="dark"` keeps @void/md's markdown and code colours dark whatever the device's setting. The `:root` block in `pages/style.css` is shadcn's light default and is never shown. Density is moderate: a 72rem container, generous hero spacing, compact controls.

The site ships in several languages, including Arabic, so right-to-left is a first-class requirement of the visual system, not an afterthought. Which languages appear comes from the app's locales (`useLocales()`), never from a hard-coded list.
keyCharacteristics: System fonts only: system-ui sans and the platform mono, no web fonts.
1px rules divide sections into ruled grids; surfaces are flat.
Code windows with file tabs, and a terminal window beside them, are the signature elements.
Right-to-left first-class: logical properties, mirrored arrows, code stays left-to-right.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Violet is the only hue on the page. It marks what to look at (code tags, prompts, arrows, icons, links, the current page and language, focus) and never fills a surface or a button; its only fills are the 4px fact dots.

rules.name: The White Button Rule
rules.body: The primary action is white ink on the ground colour, not violet. The accent stays a pointer, not a fill.

rules.name: The System Fonts Rule
rules.body: system-ui for all text and the platform mono for code. No web fonts, ever (a PRODUCT.md brand commitment).

rules.name: The Joined Letters Rule
rules.body: h1 and h2 get -0.025em letter-spacing, except in right-to-left pages, where it is `normal`: Arabic letters join, and tracking breaks them apart.

rules.name: The Kept Whole Rule
rules.body: A file or tool name inside a translated sentence must not break or flip: pass it to the sentence as `<bdi dir="ltr" class="whitespace-nowrap">` (the `file()` helper in `src/home/HomeSections.tsx`). Terminal commands break only between words (each word `whitespace-nowrap`), so "ar-EG" never splits into what reads as another command.

rules.name: The Ruled Gap Rule
rules.body: For a grid whose column count changes, draw the rules with `gap-px` over a `bg-border` grid, each cell on the ground colour, so 1px rules fall between cells at any count. All direction-dependent spacing uses logical properties (`ps`/`pe`, `ms-auto`, `border-e`, `inline-start`), so layouts mirror in right-to-left pages with no extra rules.

rules.name: The Logical Sides Rule
rules.body: Never use left/right for spacing, borders or floats; use start/end. Where a dependency uses physical sides (the @void/md heading anchors), override it with logical ones, as `pages/style.css` does.

rules.name: The Rules Not Shadows Rule
rules.body: Divide and group with 1px rules (`--border`). Shadows are reserved for the code and terminal windows.

dos: Do keep the site dark on every page: `class="dark"` and `data-theme="dark"` on `<html>`, set once in `void.config.ts`.
Do use `--brand` (oklch(0.68 0.19 285)) as the only accent, for pointers, never for fills.
Do use system-ui for text and the platform mono for code.
Do use logical properties for every direction-dependent style, and mirror arrows with `rtl:-scale-x-100`.
Do keep code blocks `dir="ltr"` in every language.
Do list languages from the app's locales, each named in its own language.
Do divide sections with 1px rules (`--border`, oklch(1 0 0 / 12%)).
Do keep file and tool names in translated sentences whole and left-to-right with `<bdi dir="ltr" class="whitespace-nowrap">`.
Do take the repository's address from `src/shell/project.ts` (`REPO`, `RELEASES`), never a copy of the URL.
donts: Don't add letter-spacing to headings in right-to-left pages.
Don't hard-code the list of languages.
Don't use gradient heroes, glow or marketing claims.
Don't use left/right for spacing, borders or floats.
Don't style anything from the `:root` light palette; it is never shown.
Don't put a theme class on a wrapper element; the theme lives on `<html>`.
